identity: The 107-atom neutral singlet complex represented by reactant.xyz, consisting of an IPr-ligated Cu–OCH3 fragment and an ortho-quinol-imine substrate; product.xyz is the corresponding 1,4-addition connectivity endpoint.
solvent_boundary: DCE continuum solvent may be used, but the chosen treatment must be reported
atom_mapping: XYZ row order is the fixed atom identity within each file; do not infer a TS atom mapping from paper labels
